title: Three months into building Riftborne — a free WoW/Diablo-inspired RPG for PC and Android with working multiplayer, five classes, and raids
author: DecentQuail3465
selftext:
Hey everyone! I wanted to introduce **Riftborne**, a fantasy RPG I’ve been developing for about **three months**, and share what’s built, what I’m working on, and how you can get involved.

The inspiration is a mix of **World of Warcraft’s exploration, classes, and group content** with **Diablo’s action combat and loot progression**. Riftborne will be **free to play**, with **PC and Android crossplay**.

**What’s already in the game**

**Working multiplayer:** Multiplayer is already functioning and syncing properly. PC and Android builds exist, with ongoing improvements to performance, controls, and the overall experience.

**Five playable classes:**

* **Warrior:** Melee damage, heavy attacks, crowd control, and defensive abilities.
* **Paladin:** Holy melee combat with tanking, healing, and damage options.
* **Ranger:** Ranged attacks, area damage, control, and mobility.
* **Arcanist:** Offensive magic, freezing abilities, area attacks, and teleportation.
* **Cleric:** Healing, shields, group support, and offensive light magic.

Classes have their own spellbooks, cooldowns, level-based ability unlocks, and customizable action bars, with desktop and touchscreen controls.

**Modular armor:** Your equipment changes your character’s appearance. Helmets, chest armor, gloves, pants, and boots are separate pieces, allowing you to mix equipment instead of being locked into one complete outfit. The custom armor selection will continue to grow.

**Dungeons and bosses:** The **Hollow Crypt** includes **Morvhal, the Ossuary King**, a multiphase boss with bone spikes, summoned undead, Soul Nova, charging attacks, and an increasingly aggressive final phase.

**Raid content:** **The Sundered Spire** is implemented as a raid designed for **up to 10 players**, featuring:

* **Gorrath, the Riftbound Colossus:** Quake rings, fissures, meteors, soak mechanics, and collapsing-floor hazards.
* **Vaelith, the Soulsplitter:** Soul tethers, dangerous orbs, interrupts, and split echoes.
* **Aeon Maw, the Rift Leviathan:** Rotating beams, gravity wells, and a rising rift tide.

Raid mechanics are networked across the group. These encounters still need broader testing to refine balance, difficulty, and coordination.

**What I’m working on now**

The biggest current focus is rebuilding the world **one region at a time**, starting with **Blackpine**. I’m working through the terrain, roads, rivers, bridges, village layout, and buildings before adding the environmental detail.

**Every model in the finished game will be custom-made for Riftborne.** I won’t be using free models downloaded from the internet. Characters, creatures, weapons, armor, buildings, props, and vegetation will follow the game’s own art direction.

Combat feel, animations, effects, UI, Android optimization, and the update experience are also ongoing priorities.

**What’s planned**

The roadmap includes expanding the realms and regions, quests, class progression, equipment, dungeons, raids, and PvP. The foundations are there, but there’s still plenty of development, testing, and polish ahead.

**How AI is involved**

I’m using AI heavily to help code the game, develop tools, and create assets. I want to be transparent about that. There’s still a lot of direction, testing, fixing, and iteration involved in bringing everything together.

**Screenshots and videos**

**I’ll post screenshots in the Discord once the first region is finished. I’m not sharing gameplay videos yet, and won’t until I’m comfortable with how the game looks and plays.** I want to give it the time it needs before presenting it properly.

**Beta testing**

You can apply for beta testing through the Discord. I especially need people interested in testing:

* **PvP:** Class matchups, balance, ability interactions, and responsiveness.
* **Raids:** Mechanics, group coordination, synchronization, and difficulty.
* **Dungeons:** Encounters, progression, bugs, and balance.
* **PC and Android:** Performance, controls, and crossplay.

**Beta testers will receive a special in-game item at release, along with an exclusive tag showing they supported Riftborne before launch**, as a thank-you for helping test and shape the game.

**Community staff**

I’ll also be looking for people interested in helping with **support tickets, player questions, and community moderation**. If that sounds like something you’d enjoy, join the Discord and let me know.

**Fair warning: I only opened the Discord today, so it’s still pretty empty!** I’m just starting to build the community, and anyone joining now will be among the first.

If you’d like to follow development, apply for testing, or get involved with the community:

[**Join the Riftborne Discord**](https://discord.gg/bXs24dTK6N)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/DecentQuail3465 please add details on how AI was used to make this. Just stating that you used AI doesn't pass the rule. The community is a dev community, add dev details. Rule 4 is there to make sure promotional posts contribute by getting into the process and actual development. There's a real risk of the sub being swamped by self-promotion. If you don't update, this post may be removed.

comments.author: maxneuds
comments.body:
Are you happy with the hunyuan 2.1 results? Personally I am not really happy with image to 3d. Even on high triangles the results still have too many problems especially for humanoid models. It gets better with a Hi3D refine step but the results are still nothing I would personally like to release. 😑

Btw do yourself a favor and change the project name to something else without born or bound. At least the game's name should not be straight from Claude.

replies.author: DecentQuail3465
replies.body:
I have mixed feelings about Hunyuan 2.1 so far. It seems to perform much better with environmental assets and props than humanoid characters. Increasing the triangle count doesn't necessarily improve the actual quality or topology either.

Right now, we're experimenting with different generation and refinement workflows. Most of what I've shown for Riftborne is still early development material being used to establish the world's layout and visual direction.

I definitely don't intend to release models straight out of an AI generator. There's still a lot of room for improvement, particularly with topology, textures, rigging, and animation. The goal is to use AI to accelerate development without sacrificing the quality of the finished game.

replies.author: maxneuds
replies.body:
Personally I settled with only using dummies for now and simple refinements for environment and props.
All of it will be refined before I got the rest done because art and modeling advanced a lot during the last year and if this pace goes on, next year there will be a lot better tools.

comments.author: VortexAssetStudio
comments.body: Getting networked raids and crossplay working in Godot in 3 months is crazy impressive. With 5 classes, spellbooks, and modular armor slots, the 2D icon workload for your action bars and loot tables must be huge, especially since you're skipping free assets. Do you already have a consistent art style locked in for all the gear and spell icons or are you still working on that part of the UI?
